description: Living risk register entry (ADR-0016). Persistent per-risk entity that evolves during execution (probability/impact/exposure/owner/response/status). Fed by the Project Risk Assessment (applicable prompts) or created manually. Change history is native (track_changes / Version + timeline); the mandatory functional reason is posted as a native timeline Comment from the transient Update note.

fields.description: Lightweight lifecycle for monitoring during execution (no workflow). Materialized = the risk occurred and is now an issue/deviation.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Date the risk was first identified.
fields.label: Identified on

fields.description: Person accountable for watching and responding to this risk.
fields.label: Risk owner

fields.description: The concrete risk. Suggested form: because of <cause>, <uncertain event> may occur, which would lead to <effect>.
fields.label: Risk description
Probability
fields.options:
Low likelihood
Medium likelihood
High likelihood

fields.description: Derived from probability x impact. Read-only.
fields.label: Exposure
fields.options:
Low exposure
Medium exposure
High exposure

fields.description: Could this potentially affect an authorized/controlled condition (scope, committed date, baseline, authorized economics)? Signal only — it does not create a Change Request.
fields.label: May affect controlled condition

fields.description: Manually identified risk (not derived from a questionnaire prompt).
fields.label: Manual risk

fields.description: Assessment that identified this risk (empty for manually created risks).
fields.label: Source assessment

fields.description: Reason for the change (why the risk changed). Required when a material field changes.
fields.label: Update note
